frozen_design_provenance.scope: The eight-step design, methods, update rule, endpoints, and failure policy were first committed here before the extended showdown result was stored.
frozen_design_provenance.qualification: This is a retrospective frozen design, not a prospective preregistration. The present file contains later integrity metadata and validation clarifications and is not claimed to be byte-for-byte untouched since first execution.

prior_observation_disclosure.observed_before_freeze: The same N=20, Ra=30000, seed=0 initial state had already been used for a one-step composed-versus-loop-cut intervention at amplitudes 0.01, 0.025, and 0.05. At amplitude 0.025 the composed action had already won; the observed add/remove selected-cell overlaps were 0.40/0.10.
prior_observation_disclosure.not_previously_observed_as_a_stored_resu: The three repeated eight-step trajectories and the frozen-flow branch endpoint were not stored before the frozen-design commit.
prior_observation_disclosure.interpretation: The showdown is confirmatory follow-up evidence under a frozen repeated-decision procedure, but its operating point was informed by prior favourable single-step evidence.

integrity_amendments_after_freeze: Corrected the original 'preregistered' wording and replaced the placeholder lock time with the actual Git commit provenance.

Added an explicit numerical-equivalence tolerance and stricter completeness/failure recording. These are conservative integrity rules added after the original freeze and must not be described as preregistered.
protocol.purpose: Test whether accounting for the two-way fixed-point feedback changes repeated design decisions, not only a single derivative check.

parameters.volume_constraint: Preserve the initial mean projected density by a deterministic uniform-shift bisection after every balanced action.
parameters.candidate_policy: At every iteration perturb the raw design variable by +amplitude on the 5% most beneficial cells and -amplitude on the 5% least beneficial cells, clip raw values to [0,1], then apply a deterministic uniform-shift bisection to recover the initial mean projected density before one true coupled forward solve.
parameters.budget_label: equal raw-design proposal rule and equal projected-volume target; not an equal wall-time, VJP-count, or realised per-cell physical-density L1 budget
parameters.nonconvergence_policy: Record the failed candidate and stop only that branch. Do not replace the seed, Rayleigh number, step size, or method.

fairness.note: The composed adjoint intentionally costs more inner VJPs. Runtime and VJP counts are reported rather than hidden. Projection and clipping can change realised per-cell physical-density movement, so the controlled budget is described as a common raw-design proposal rule plus a common projected-volume target.

endpoints.primary: True coupled objective after eight fixed-budget decisions, provided the branch completes.
secondary: Percentage reduction from the common initial objective
Area under the eight-step objective trajectory
Number of objectively improving candidate steps
Wall time and cross-component adjoint VJP count
endpoints.success_condition: All three branches complete all eight steps and the composed-gradient final true objective is lower than each shortcut by more than the numerical-equivalence tolerance; all failures, numerical ties, and contrary outcomes remain reportable.

numerical_equivalence.rule: Two final objectives are numerically equivalent when their absolute difference is at most absolute_J + relative_J * max(abs(J_a), abs(J_b)).
